map.→ 打开阅读（打开率/完读）评估工具: -> Open the reading (open rate / completion) evaluation tool
map.内容阅读效果在线评估工具，输入打开率、完读率与互动率等指标评估文章表现，辅助运营: Online content reading effect evaluation tool: enter open rate, completion rate and interaction rate to assess article performance and support optimisation. Runs entirely in the front end.
map.打开率/完读率多少算正常？: What open rate and completion rate count as normal?
map.打开率通常 5–30%（看粉丝质量与标题），完读率 20–60%；三者都高说明内: The open rate is usually 5-30% (depending on follower quality and the headline) and the completion rate 20-60%; all three being high means the content matches well. Here the open rate of 30%, completion rate of 60% and interaction rate of 12.5% are all above average.
map.推送效果复盘：录入发送/打开/完读/互动与阅读时长，用打开率看标题封面、完读率看: Review the push notification effect: enter sends, opens, completions, interactions and reading time, using the open rate for the headline and cover, the completion rate for content quality and the interaction rate for resonance.
map.算例（发送8000/打开2400/完读1440/互动300/阅读120秒/总字数: Worked example (8000 sent, 2400 opened, 1440 completed, 300 interactions, 120 s reading, 800 total characters)
map.综合评分：三率各按阈值给 0–3 分（满分 9），≥75% 优秀、50–75%: Overall score: each of the three rates is scored 0-3 against its threshold (maximum 9), 75% or above excellent, 50%-75% good, 25%-50% average, below 25% poor, giving a quick grade.
map.阅读完成度怎么理解？: How should reading completion be understood?
map.阅读完成度诊断：用 实际阅读时长 ÷ 预期时长（字数÷5）看用户是否真的读完，定: Reading completion diagnosis: compare actual reading time against expected time (word count / 5) to see whether readers really finished, and locate the low-quality traffic that opens and leaves.
map.预期时长 = 字数 ÷ 5（按约 5 字/秒阅读速度），阅读完成度 = 实际时长: Expected time = word count / 5 (at about 5 characters per second), and reading completion = actual time / expected time. A low value (for example below 60%) means readers did not finish, which may be because the opening is not engaging, the piece is too long, or expectations do not match.
map.：打开率 = 2400÷8000×100% = 30.0%；完读率 = 1440: : open rate = 2400/8000 x 100% = 30.0%; completion rate = 1440/2400 x 100% = 60.0%; interaction rate = 300/2400 x 100% = 12.5%; expected time = 800/5 = 160 s; reading completion = 120/160 x 100% = 75.0%. All three rates pass, giving an overall 9/9 = 100% and "excellent reading effect". The tool outputs the four dimensions with an overall score and optimisation advice.
